login_no_flow: Start signing in from the application you want to use.
link_google_intro: An account for {email} exists already. Enter its password once to sign in with Google from now on.
google_cancelled: Signing in with Google was cancelled.
google_unverified: Google has not confirmed this email address, so it cannot be used here.
google_no_account: There is no account for this Google address. Ask for an invitation, or sign in another way.
verify_wait_intro: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm the address, then come back here.
verify_resent: A new link is on its way, if the address needs one.
verify_still_waiting: The address is not confirmed yet. Open the link in the email first.
change_password_intro: Your account now needs a password of at least {min} characters. Choose a new one to continue.
flow_expired_intro: This sign-in has expired or was opened in another browser. Go back to the application and start again.
signup_terms: I accept the terms of use
signup_closed: New accounts are made by invitation here.
forgot_intro: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot_sent: If {email} has an account, a link is on its way. It works once and for a short time.
reset_done: Your password is changed, and you are signed out everywhere. Sign in again with the new password.
verify_confirmed_next: You can close this page and continue where you were.
invite_other_account: You are signed in as {email}. The invitation is for another address.
invite_created: Your account is ready and the invitation is accepted.
invite_confirm_address: Confirm your email address with the link we sent before you sign in.
logout_intro: Do you want to sign out? You will be signed out of every application that uses this sign-in.
logout_done: You are signed out. You can close this page.
account_email_sent: We sent a link to {email}. The address changes when you open it.
reauth_intro: For this, enter your password again.
security_set_password_intro: You sign in with Google. A password lets you sign in without it as well.
security_password_note: Your other devices will be signed out.
security_password_changed: Your password is changed. Other sessions signed out: {n}.
security_delete_intro: Your account and everything stored about you will be deleted, in every application that uses this sign-in. This cannot be undone.
sessions_intro: Sign out any device you do not recognise, then change your password.
connections_intro: An account always keeps at least one way to sign in.
orgs_none: You have no roles yet. When someone invites you, the invitation shows here.
admin_delete_confirm: Delete {email} and everything stored about it? This cannot be undone.
admin_reset_sent: A reset link is on its way to {email}.
admin_create_intro: Without a password, the person chooses one with a reset link or an invitation.
service_create_intro: For scripts and other programs. Give it roles like a person, then create a token.
service_token_once: Copy the token now: it is shown only once.
service_delete_confirm: Delete the service account {name} with its tokens and roles?
error_network: The service cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error_invalid_credentials: The email address or the password is wrong.
error_too_many: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
error_password_too_short: The password needs at least {min} characters.
error_password_too_common: This password is too common. Choose another one.
error_bad_email: That is not an email address.
error_flow_expired: This sign-in has expired. Go back to the application and start again.
error_link_invalid: The link is used, expired or replaced by a newer one.
error_signup_closed: New accounts are made by invitation here.
error_terms: Accept the terms of use to continue.
error_last_holder: This would leave no one with this role. Give it to someone else first.
error_last_method: This is your only way to sign in. Set a password first.
error_wrong_account: Sign in to the account Google named, or start again.
error_google_unavailable: Google sign-in is not available right now.
mail_footer: You are receiving this email because it concerns your {brand} account.
mail_link_fallback: If the button does not work, open this address:
mail_verify_email_intro: Confirm that {email} is your address to finish setting up your {brand} account.
mail_verify_email_expiry: The link is valid for {hours} hours.
mail_verify_email_ignore: If you did not create this account, you can ignore this email.
mail_reset_password_intro: We received a request to reset the password of your {brand} account ({email}).
mail_reset_password_expiry: The link is valid for {minutes} minutes.
mail_reset_password_ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password stays as it is.
mail_account_exists_intro: Someone (perhaps you) tried to create a {brand} account with {email}. You already have an account with this address.
mail_account_exists_hint: If you have forgotten your password, choose “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page.
mail_password_changed_intro: The password of your {brand} account was changed on {when}.
mail_password_changed_not_you: If this was not you, choose a new password right away.
mail_email_changed_intro: The email address of your {brand} account was changed to {new_email}.
mail_email_changed_not_you: If this was not you, contact us right away.
mail_new_sign_in_intro: Your {brand} account was signed in from a new device: {device}, {when}.
mail_new_sign_in_not_you: If this was not you, change your password.
mail_session_revoked_reuse_intro: A sign-in token of your {brand} account was used twice, which can mean it was copied. To be safe, we ended every session on every device.
mail_session_revoked_reuse_advice: Sign in again. If this happens again, change your password.
mail_invitation_intro: {inviter} invited you to join {scope} on {brand} as {role}.
mail_invitation_expiry: The invitation is valid for {days} days.
mail_invitation_ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
